en-US.name: F1 Predict
en-US.subtitle: Formula 1 Prediction Game
en-US.description:
F1 Predict lets you compete with friends by predicting the top 10 drivers in every Formula 1 race.

Create or join private leagues, lock in your driver order before qualifying, and watch your score update live as the race unfolds.

Features:
• Predict the top 10 finishing order for every Grand Prix and Sprint race
• Live race dashboard — see how your picks compare to the real-time positions
• Private leagues — invite friends and track standings all season
• Bonus bets — predict the fastest lap, safety cars, and DNFs for extra points
• Push notifications when predictions lock and results are published
en-US.release_notes: Initial release of F1 Predict for the 2026 Formula 1 season.
